title: Unit 9 Quiz — The Science of Fun
subtitle: Assessment after Unit 9 · v1 · 13 slides · ExamView L4U9 · how the quiz runs → what the app marks (39) and what Neritan marks (11) → the full answer key Q1–Q34 → the Q35 writing rubric → the Q36 speaking script with its picture → reading the result by skill

content: Administer the ExamView Unit 9 quiz: play TR 9.1 for Q1 and TR 9.2 for Q30–34, and run the Q36 speaking prompts from the merry-go-round picture.
Mark the two open responses — the Q35 writing and the Q36 speaking — and any sentence in Q7–15 whose wording the key did not predict.
Read the result by skill (vocabulary 11 · grammar 14 · reading 9 · listening 5 · writing 5 · speaking 6) and pick what to re-teach.
language: Check the double comparative the more… the more… in both halves of the sentence.
Check which defining a thing, with the phrase conjugated to fit (have → has, live → live).
Check the force vocabulary: push, pull, spin, friction, gravity, balance, forward, backward.
Check cause and effect with so, so that and as a result in the writing.
